method.c46_composite: The plotted c46 is a composite assembled by field_plots.py ours() from per-D run files: c23 for D=2, then stems c25..c46 overlaid in order (later stems overwrite the cells they re-ran). Final origin per cell: c45 full-grid runs supply 528 of 600 cells; literal c46-config runs (c46_d10/d20/d40, multiplier 100 only) supply 72 cells (D 10, 20, 40 at 100xD, 24 functions each). c46 differs from c45 only by prefix_low_beta=0.15 from D>=10, so the other 528 cells are c45 runs, assumed identical under c46 (not re-run on this grid).
